recreation_brief:
1. SLIDE SETUP: Create a 16:9 slide with light-gray background #f0f0f0. Use a sans-serif font for all text.
2. TITLE BAR: Draw a full-width white rectangle across the top (approx. 0-10% of slide height) with a 2pt blue #2980b9 border. Center inside it the text 'Training Samples with Labels [0,1] (Two Classes)' in large bold black (~28pt).
3. SLIDE NUMBER: In the top-right corner, draw a small circle (blue #2980b9 outline, white fill - placeholder, color not specified in source) containing the number '2' in black.
4. POSITIVE CLASS PANEL (left half, leftmost, approx. x 3-19%, y 15-92%): Draw a white rectangle with a 2pt red #c0392b border. At the top of the panel add the bold red #c0392b header 'Positive Class' and directly below it the italic black subtitle '"Shoot the Enemy"'. Inside the panel stack 5 black-outline enemy airplane drawings vertically on white background, each with a small skull/crossbones marking.
5. POSITIVE LABEL COLUMN: Immediately to the right of the Positive panel (i.e., between the two class panels), stack 5 small red #c0392b filled rectangles vertically, each containing '+1' in white text, one aligned with each of the 5 planes. Above the column add the black header 'Label'.
6. NEGATIVE CLASS PANEL (left half, right of the +1 column, approx. x 25-41%, y 15-92%): Draw a white rectangle with a 2pt green #2ecc71 border. At the top add the bold green #2ecc71 header 'Negative Class' and below it the italic black subtitle '"Safe"'. Inside, stack 5 black-outline passenger airplane drawings vertically (no enemy markings).
7. NEGATIVE LABEL COLUMN: Immediately to the right of the Negative panel, stack 5 small green #2ecc71 filled rectangles vertically, each containing '0' in white text, aligned with the 5 planes. Above the column add the black header 'Label'.
8. ACTIVATION FUNCTION BOX (right half, top, approx. x 50-97%, y 13-34%): Draw a white rectangle with a thin black outline (placeholder - border color not specified in source). Title it 'Activation Function' in bold black. Inside, add the black text lines 'Sigmoid function (0 , +1)' and 'Threshold at "0.5"', plus a graph: black axes on a light #f0f0f0 plot area with a purple #8e44ad S-shaped sigmoid curve.
9. TRAINING DIAGRAM (right half, middle, approx. x 50-97%, y 36-64%): Draw a white rectangle with a red #c0392b header reading 'Training'. Build a left-to-right flowchart connected by black right-arrows: text 'Input Sample' -> red #c0392b rectangle labeled 'Model' containing black text '[Any value] -> (-1, +1)' and a small purple #8e44ad sigmoid-curve icon -> text 'Predicted Class' -> orange #f39c12 circle labeled 'LOSS' -> text 'Label of Input Sample (+1, 0)'. Add a black mouse-cursor arrow pointing at the Model box from the left.
10. EVALUATION DIAGRAM (right half, bottom, approx. x 50-97%, y 66-92%): Draw a white rectangle with a red #c0392b header reading 'Evaluation'. Build a left-to-right flowchart connected by black right-arrows: text 'Test Sample' -> red #c0392b rectangle labeled 'Model' containing black text '[Any value] -> (-1, +1)' and a small purple #8e44ad sigmoid icon -> text 'Predicted Class' -> blue #2980b9 text '(+1, 0)'.
11. TYPOGRAPHY CHECK: All text sans-serif; title large and bold; class headers bold and colored (red #c0392b / green #2ecc71); quoted subtitles italic; all diagram body text black.
